fields.name: Ninebot scooter
fields.description: The E3 Pro is a fresh take on getting you where you want to go. Beginner-friendly scooter, great portability and a lightweight frame make it a breeze to take anywhere, anytime. Equipped with dual suspension and bright 256 RGB lights, the E3 Pro makes any journey over bumpy terrain stable and fun so you can run errands and explore up to 34 miles on one charge.
